content: Claude Code plugin layout (code.claude.com plugins-reference): manifest at .claude-plugin/plugin.json (only name required); components at plugin root: skills/<name>/SKILL.md (preferred over commands/), commands/, agents/*.md, hooks/hooks.json, .mcp.json, bin/ (on Bash PATH), scripts/ by convention. Components namespaced plugin:name. CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT changes on update (do not write state); CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA=~/.claude/plugins/data/<id>/ persists across updates. userConfig with sensitive:true stores in keychain. Variables not present in Bash tool env. claude plugin validate --strict for CI.
